description: Checks the remaining Hash Credits, tier, and lifetime usage of the configured Rel-Time API key (`GET /api/v1/account`). If no API key is configured yet, returns the 4 available Rel-Time Tiers (`universal` $3, `launch` $5/25, `standard` $50/500, `enterprise` $399/5,000) and payment options (`lightning` or `stripe`) so you can ask the user which tier they want to provision in chat.

api_key.description: Optional: pass a `rel_key_...` API key to check its balance AND automatically save it to ~/.reltime/api_key.json for all future calls.

name: reltime_account_status
